note: Big-ticket items for Price Check's showcase finale, written for this project. Each item has a kind (a showcase draws one item from three different kinds) and, for each country, its name and price in cents in that country's dollars. Prices are typical retail prices in 2026 estimated by hand for each country (US dollars in the US, Canadian dollars in Canada, each estimated on its own, not converted): they are not quotes from any shop. A trip that only makes sense from one country has its own name in the other (Colorado / Whistler).
